title: Clovis site discovered in New Mexico
place: Blackwater Draw, near Clovis, New Mexico, United States
summary: Nineteen-year-old Ridgely Whiteman found the Clovis site. For decades Clovis people were thought to be the first Americans; most researchers now reject this, as several sites are at least 1,000 years older.
why: Shows how one site shaped, and then misled, the story of the first Americans.

notes.problem: 'Abandoned after the early 2000s' unsupported; source says Clovis First is 'today ... generally rejected' with no date (Monte Verde was accepted in the late 1990s).
